name: 存储雷达报告
description: 扫描手机存储，找出大文件、视频、APK、压缩包、下载目录、微信目录和疑似重复文件，生成空间去向报告与清理建议。
description_en: Scan storage for large files, videos, APKs, archives, downloads, WeChat folders, and duplicate candidates, then generate a readable cleanup report.

permissions.name: android.permission.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
permissions.desc: 用于扫描手机存储并统计文件占用
permissions.desc_en: Scan phone storage and calculate file usage

permissions.name: android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
permissions.desc: 用于读取 Android 12 及以下的存储文件信息
permissions.desc_en: Read storage files on Android 12 and below

apis.name: scanStorageRadar
apis.desc: 扫描存储并生成空间雷达报告，适用于“空间到底去哪了”“找出大文件和重复文件”等提示词
apis.desc_en: Scan storage and generate a space radar report

apis.name: generateCleanupPlan
apis.desc: 基于扫描结果生成清理计划，不直接删除文件，等待用户确认后再交给文件/清理模块执行
apis.desc_en: Generate a cleanup plan without deleting files; execute only after user confirmation
paramDesc: 期望释放空间 MB，默认 1024
paramDesc_en: Target free space in MB, default 1024

apis.name: generateSmartCleanupAdvice
apis.desc: 扫描手机存储后调用 AI 生成普通用户能看懂的清理建议，不直接删除文件
apis.desc_en: Scan storage and use AI to generate readable cleanup advice without deleting files
paramDesc: 关注点，例如 大文件/重复文件/下载目录/微信目录
输出语言：zh/en，默认自动判断
最大输出 token，默认 768，上限 1024
paramDesc_en: Focus such as large files, duplicates, downloads, or WeChat folders
Output language: zh/en, auto-detected by default
Max output tokens, default 768, capped at 1024
